entries.problem: Cloud agent had GH_TOKEN but no VERCEL_TOKEN, so 'ship on Vercel' could not be completed unattended.
entries.learning: Building marketing sites as Next.js static export (output: 'export' + env-driven basePath) lets one codebase deploy to GitHub Pages immediately for review while staying 1-click Vercel-importable — no agent credentials required for a live URL.
entries.action: Default client marketing sites to static export with a Pages CI workflow as the credential-free preview path; add VERCEL_TOKEN to Cloud Agent secrets to enable direct Vercel ships.

entries.problem: Client sites need premium imagery before the client has supplied real photos.
entries.learning: Generating cohesive concept photography (consistent palette/mood prompts) and post-processing with sharp (resize + mozjpeg, <200KB per image) yields a polished, performant site that's honest when labeled 'concept photography' in captions.
entries.action: Reuse the prompt style + sharp pipeline (see repo history) for client-site imagery; always label generated images as concept work in visible captions.
